name: Claude Code
free_plan_limits: Not included in the Free plan
since_note: First released February 2025; generally available May 2025 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Heavy coding work from the terminal
notes: Pro is $17/mo if billed yearly. Team standard seat is $25/mo ($20 yearly). Limits reset every 5 hours and weekly; Max is $100 and Ultra $200. Editor, cloud and API-key use not confirmed on the pricing page.

name: OpenAI Codex
free_plan_limits: Quick coding tasks on the Free plan; limits vary by model
usage_note: API key option is billed at API token prices
since_note: Cloud agent research preview launched May 16, 2025 (OpenAI).
best_for: Coding agent bundled with ChatGPT plans
notes: Included in ChatGPT Free, Go ($8), Plus ($20), Pro (from $100), Business. Business is $20/user billed yearly, $25 monthly. Limits depend on model and task size; extra credits can be bought.

name: Cursor
free_plan_limits: Limited agent, chat and Tab use (no numbers given)
usage_note: Third-party models billed at API list price from prepaid credit
since_note: Anysphere incorporated 2022; product launch year not stated (Wikipedia).
best_for: AI-first code editor for daily work
notes: Pricing page now lists Free, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200, Teams from $30/seat. Old Hobby/Pro plans are closed to new customers. Plus has no cloud agents or third-party models. Bring-your-own-key not stated.

name: GitHub Copilot
free_plan_limits: 2,000 completions a month, limited chat and agent use
usage_note: 1 AI credit = $0.01; Pro includes $15 of credits
best_for: Cheap AI help inside your existing editor
notes: Pro $10, Pro+ $39, Max $100. Business and Enterprise prices not listed on the page. Free has no cloud agent or code review. Completions don't use credits.

name: Google Antigravity
free_plan_limits: Unlimited Tab and Command, basic weekly rate limits
usage_note: Business also has a pay-as-you-go option with no seat fee
best_for: Free agent coding if you use Google
notes: Paid access comes via Google AI Pro ($19.99/mo, from Google One page) or Ultra ($99.99). Antigravity page gives no price for those. Business from $30/seat; billing term not stated. An Antigravity CLI exists.

name: CodeRabbit
free_plan_limits: 14-day trial; free reviews on public repos
usage_note: Only developers who open pull requests are charged
best_for: Automatic AI review of pull requests
notes: Reviews code; it doesn't write apps. Essentials $24/user yearly, Team $60 ($48), Advanced $90 ($72). Extra reviews $0.25 per file. Free only for open source repos.

name: OpenCode
since_note: First released June 2025 per one secondary source.
best_for: Open-source terminal agent with any model
notes: MIT licensed. Works with 200+ providers or your own ChatGPT/Copilot subscription. Go is 'from $10/month'. Desktop app and mobile app exist. IDE use not stated.

name: Gemini CLI
free_plan_limits: Free tier moved to Antigravity CLI on June 18, 2026
small_business_plan: Gemini API key (pay as you go)
usage_note: Billed by Gemini API or Vertex AI usage
best_for: Open-source terminal agent on Gemini API
notes: The tool is free (Apache 2.0); you pay for API usage or a Code Assist license. No monthly price stated, so cost not confirmed. Page says no free tier or Google AI plans any more.

name: Windsurf
free_plan_limits: Light quota, limited models, unlimited Tab and inline edits
usage_note: Extra usage billed at API prices
since_note: Windsurf Editor generally available November 13, 2024 (company changelog).
best_for: Editor with agents and a cloud option
notes: Now sold as Devin Desktop; windsurf.com redirects to devin.ai/pricing. Pro $20, Max $200, Teams $80 plus $40 per dev seat. Quotas refresh daily and weekly; exact sizes not stated.
